GET_DMP_Command_Configuration.description: Loads active Agent 4 status configuration items.

FILTER_Config_CurrentOperationMode.description: Finds current DMP COMMAND operation mode.

Select_ConfigEntries.description: Maps each configuration row to a mode-resolved JSON key-value fragment, replacing the slow per-row loop with a single non-looping data operation.

CMP_ConfigJsonText.description: Completes the configuration JSON text by wrapping all resolved property fragments in braces.

CMP_ConfigObject.description: Converts the generated configuration JSON text into the central configuration object for this run.

VAR_ConfigObject.description: Stores resolved status configuration values, built via Select+Join instead of a per-row loop.
